description: Defines a generic double buffer data structure with functions and inline methods for buffer management, including allocation, peeking, enqueuing, retrieving the latest element, current element, and modification status.

methods.name: dbuf_alloc
methods.description: Allocates a new element in the double buffer and returns a pointer to it.

methods.name: dbuf_latest_get
methods.description: Retrieves the latest enqueued element and indicates if the buffer was modified.
